package.name: marine_control_py
package.description: Python device-control library: the rclpy sibling of the C++ marine_control::ControlServer. Publishes a ControlSet describing a node's bound parameters on a bridge-correct heartbeat (state, device->operator) and applies inbound ControlValue (change, operator->device) by setting the bound parameter. No Qt — the operator station renders the set. ADR-0003 (D4/D5/D6).
